basic_details.scholarship_name: Doha Institute for Graduate Studies (Tamim & Sanad Scholarships)
basic_details.offering_entity: Doha Institute for Graduate Studies & Qatar Fund for Development (QFFD)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Doha Institute for Graduate Studies (Wadi Al Banat Campus, Lusail / Doha, State of Qatar)
basic_details.major_restrictions: School of Social Sciences and Humanities (Philosophy, History, Sociology, Politics & International Relations, Media Studies, Linguistics, Critical Security Studies) and School of Economics, Administration and Public Policy (Development Economics, Public Policy, Public Administration).
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~100 to 140 comprehensive graduate scholarships awarded annually across Tamim (Academic Merit) and Sanad (Need & Academic Merit) schemes
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open international competition; Pakistani postgraduates in public policy, development economics, and international affairs secure ~6 to 12 awards annually
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 2 years (full standard duration of Master's degree), subject to maintaining a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0 / 4.0

nationality_requirements: Open to international applicants from the Arab world and international students globally (Pakistan eligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No formal age limit; evaluated on academic merit, research quality, and interview performance.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Recognized 4-year Bachelor's degree (16 years education) from an HEC-recognized university in a relevant social science, economics, humanities, or quantitative discipline with high academic standing (minimum 80% aggregate or CGPA 3.00 / 4.00; competitive admits typically 3.40+ / 4.00).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum B / Jayyid (Good) grade record; Jayyid Jiddan (Very Good, 3.25+) preferred.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Relevant undergraduate degree in economics, political science, sociology, international relations, public administration, or related fields.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Students in their final undergraduate semester can apply conditionally with certified interim transcripts.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Professional, policy think-tank, or NGO experience is beneficial for MPP and MPA programs.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: For English-track programs (Development Economics, Public Policy): IELTS Academic min 6.5 or TOEFL iBT min 79, or official English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate from an HEC-recognized university. For Arabic-track programs: advanced proficiency in Arabic is mandatory.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Candidates must sit an institutional Arabic and/or English diagnostic assessment during the interview stage.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Applicants apply for admission and the scholarship concurrently through the DI online admissions portal.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold concurrent scholarships from other Qatari or external entities.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition fee waiver for the complete 2-year Master's degree program (QAR 50,000 / year value).

admission_application_fee.details: Doha Institute online application is completely free of charge.

accommodation.details: Free furnished student accommodation provided in modern Doha Institute residential buildings in Lusail/Doha, including individual rooms, utilities, high-speed Wi-Fi, and fitness facilities.

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly tax-free living stipend: QAR 2,500 to 3,500 / month (~USD 685 to 960 / month; ~PKR 192,500 to 269,500 / month) disbursed directly to students.

airfare.details: Economy-class round-trip flight tickets between Pakistan and Hamad International Airport (Doha) upon initial enrollment and after graduation.

visa_fee.details: Qatari Student Residence Visa sponsorship, processing, and QID issuance fees fully covered and arranged by the Doha Institute.

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive health insurance under the Qatari government healthcare system (Hamad Medical Corporation - HMC) and private emergency coverage.

food_allowance.details: Campus dining cafeteria and self-catering kitchen facilities in residence; living costs easily managed within the monthly stipend.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Access to Doha Institute Central Library, Arab Center for Research and Policy Studies digital databases, and interlibrary loans with Qatar National Library (QNL).

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Funding available for Master's thesis fieldwork, polling data access, and presenting at regional and international academic conferences.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Free shuttle buses connecting student residences with the campus and Lusail Tram / Doha Metro stations.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single host institution (Doha Institute for Graduate Studies)
participating_institutions: Doha Institute for Graduate Studies (Lusail / Doha, State of Qatar)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Premier specialized graduate research institute in the Arab world, partnered with the Arab Center for Research and Policy Studies (ACRPS).
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Online DI application form, certified Bachelor's transcripts and degree certificates, statement of academic intent, academic writing sample or research proposal, two letters of recommendation, CV, valid passport, and personal interview.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Public Policy and Development Economics receive substantial international interest from South Asian applicants; a rigorous quantitative background and a well-articulated research sample are key discriminators.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Prepare a strong, analytical writing sample (15-20 pages) addressing contemporary economic, political, or institutional development issues in South Asia or the Global South.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Doha Institute Online Admissions & Scholarship Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register an account on the DI Admissions Portal, select desired Master's program, complete the application forms, and indicate scholarship consideration (Tamim or Sanad).
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Create online profile on the Doha Institute admissions portal (September - October).
Step 2: Fill in personal information, undergraduate academic qualifications, and upload required documents.
Step 3: Submit academic writing sample, statement of purpose, and nominate two academic referees.
Step 4: Submit application before the deadline (typically January 15; no application fee required).
Step 5: Referees submit letters of evaluation via automated institutional links.
Step 6: Academic admissions committee conducts initial file screening and releases interview invitations (February - March).
Step 7: Selected candidates participate in online video interviews conducted by faculty panels (March - April).
Step 8: Final admission and scholarship award decisions published (May).
Step 9: Accept the scholarship offer, receive Qatari student visa and e-ticket, and arrive in Doha in August.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated Track: Admission application simultaneously serves as the scholarship application form.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by referees via automated links dispatched directly to their institutional email addresses.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of Interest detailing academic background, intellectual motivations for pursuing graduate studies at DI, and how the program aligns with career ambitions.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Academic writing sample (an undergraduate thesis chapter, published paper, or analytical research paper) demonstrating critical thinking and research methodology.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Curriculum vitae detailing education, research papers, conferences, internships, and languages.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Rigorous 20 to 30-minute online interview conducted by a panel of 2-3 faculty members evaluating analytical depth, research interests, and communication skills.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: None strictly required (GRE optional); English proficiency test or MOI letter required for English-track programs.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Bachelor's degree and transcripts must be attested by HEC Pakistan, MoFA, and the Embassy of Qatar in Islamabad upon final admission.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English or Arabic translation required for any documents in Urdu.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% digital submission via the DI admissions portal.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Scanned color copies of Bachelor's degree and complete semester transcripts.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Degrees from HEC-recognized universities; attestation required upon final offer.

required_documents_checklist.specification: A sample of academic writing (e.g. undergraduate thesis, term paper, or published article) in English or Arabic.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Must demonstrate critical thinking and structured research argumentation.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Detailed essay outlining academic background and motivations for graduate study at DI.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Clearly articulate synergy with faculty research at DI.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Submitted directly by university professors who taught the applicant.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Must be sent from official institutional email addresses of Pakistani professors.

required_documents_checklist.specification: IELTS Academic (min 6.5), TOEFL iBT (min 79), or official English Medium of Instruction letter.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Institutional MOI certificate accepted for many social science disciplines.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete CV detailing academic and professional trajectory.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Highlight any published work, policy research, or volunteer engagements.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Clear color copy of applicant's passport valid for at least 18 months.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Pakistani passport must have validity through late 2027 or 2028.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Single annual admissions intake cycle for Fall semester (August commencement).

selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 25% (Quality and rigor of academic writing sample)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Doha Institute Faculty Admissions Committee, Academic Deans, and DI Scholarship Board.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Two-phase evaluation: academic dossier assessment followed by rigorous faculty panel interview.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~4,000 to 6,000 applicants globally across all graduate programs
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~4.0% among applicants reaching the interview stage
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: CGPA 3.40+ / 4.00 or 80%+ aggregate from premier Pakistani universities (QAU, LUMS, NUST, GCU, IBA, FAST)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: High intellectual curiosity, solid writing ability, strong analytical skills, and demonstrated passion for social science/policy issues.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of Pakistani top social science, economics, and international relations departments.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Qatar, Palestine, Jordan, Morocco, Pakistan, Egypt, Tunisia, Lebanon, Sudan, Algeria.

fake_websites_and_scams: Beware of fraudulent consultancy services charging fees for guaranteed Doha Institute admission.
Applications are processed exclusively through dohainstitute.edu.qa without any fee.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Doha Institute does NOT charge any application fee. Never pay an agent.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: DI does not collaborate with any commercial educational agencies or recruitment agents.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Degree and transcript attestation in Pakistan (HEC and MoFA): ~PKR 15,000 to 20,000.
Embassy of Qatar attestation fee in Islamabad: ~PKR 12,000 to 18,000.
Medical checkup in Pakistan prior to travel: ~PKR 10,000.
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: You must be fluent in Arabic for all programs. Reality: Development Economics and Public Policy are offered in English.
Myth: The scholarship requires repayment upon graduation. Reality: The scholarship is a 100% grant with no repayment or bond obligation.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial forums claim IELTS 7.0 is mandatory; the official requirement is 6.5 for English-track programs or MOI certificate.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.00 / 4.00 (Grade B) throughout the 2-year duration.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time student commitment; classroom attendance is mandatory and monitored.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Semester-end academic standing evaluation; failure to maintain minimum GPA results in academic probation and potential scholarship revocation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: External employment is prohibited under Qatari student visa regulations; on-campus graduate assistantships permitted.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: No mandatory return requirement; graduates are free to pursue doctoral studies globally or employment in Qatar/Gulf region.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Zero service bond or repayment obligation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Scholarship terminated if student withdraws without authorization or is dismissed for disciplinary infractions.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Major change permitted only within the first semester with formal academic approval.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Scholarship duration is strictly limited to standard 2 academic years; extensions are not funded.
